name: TC-SL-007 — 展开历史迭代区域 [P1]
description: 验证行展开后展示历史迭代摘要：迭代名称、状态、创建/完成时间、买手、产运、基准包

steps.expression: (() => { const expandIcon = document.querySelector('.ant-table-row-expand-icon, [class*=expand-icon]'); if (expandIcon) { expandIcon.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const expanded = document.querySelector('.ant-table-expanded-row, [class*=expanded-row]'); if (!expanded) return { found: false }; const text = expanded.textContent; const hasIteration = text.includes('迭代') || text.includes('轮次'); const hasStatus = ['草稿', '待确认', '试拍', '审核', '复核', '归档', '终止', '驳回'].some(s => text.includes(s)); const hasTime = /\d{4}[-/]\d{2}[-/]\d{2}/.test(text); return { found: true, hasIteration, hasStatus, hasTime, textPreview: text.substring(0, 300) }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 店铺列表存在有多轮迭代的店铺
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 点击行展开控件
2. 验证展开区展示历史迭代
3. 检查迭代名称、状态、时间等字段
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 展开区展示该店铺全部视觉迭代
2. 每行展示迭代名称/轮次、状态、创建/完成时间、负责买手、最近产运
3. 已归档迭代展示基准包
4. 当前应用基准包标记应用中
5. 最新迭代在前
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/店铺列表
